column1: # Only deliberate negatives belong here, and only cannot-validate records can be
# classified: the quick tier has NO baseline, so a discrepancy always fails.
# case_id is file#<case name>#<ordinal among same-named cases in that file>
# (`%`, `#`, `|`, tab in the name are %-escaped). The reason prefix must match the
# record's first item on whole `:` segments (e.g. cannot-validate:reference-error).
# `*` expands to every predicted configuration of the case. An entry (or `*`
# expansion) that matches no record is STALE and fails the run with exit 1.
